name: anki-workflows
description: Add, review, and update non-duplicate Anki cards directly or from macOS Reminders.

interface.shortDescription: Add or update reviewed Anki cards from prompts or Reminders.
interface.longDescription: Inspect a local Anki collection, apply established card styles, add or update non-duplicate cards through AnkiConnect, sync them, and optionally process learning notes from macOS Reminders.
defaultPrompt: Add or update these cards in my existing Anki setup without duplicates, then sync.
Review my English-learning cards for consistent prompts, punctuation, examples, and vocabulary supplements.
Review my pending language-learning Reminders, add the useful cards to Anki, and sync.
